agent_authored.description: DSM supplies incident waves through a 1-D spherical Earth to a local SPECFEM3D model. Boundary displacement and traction are coupled with DSM Green functions to recover scattered teleseismic waves, then added to a 1-D DSM reference.

modules.title: DSM 1-D frequency-domain solver (dsmti + spectotime)
modules.purpose: Solve radial elastodynamic equations in a spherically symmetric Earth frequency by frequency with dsmti, then convert displacement spectra to SAC waveforms with spectotime.
modules.differences: Pending 1-D DSM module only; excludes injected-wave interpolation, local 3-D SPECFEM3D and representation-integral coupling. Two checks observe the same numerical method.
